title: Ask HN: Is using AI harmful to human Critical Thinking and Decision making?
excerpt: lack of awareness of what processes technology takes over for you will lead yo cognitive decline in those areas. if they are important to you its best to try and be aware. it all depends on awareness and how its used given that awareness.
content_html:
lack of awareness of what processes technology takes over for you will lead yo cognitive decline in those areas. if they are important to you its best to try and be aware. it all depends on awareness and how its used given that awareness.

Like auto complete degrades slowly the ability to properly spell words. If you don't use it, surely you will gain more of the skills than when you do use it.
